comment: Six days and no update. I opened an account elsewhere in ten minutes.
The camera rejected my licence eleven times and then the session expired.
I moved in March and it kept saying my address could not be confirmed.
It asked me to film my face and I closed the app. Nobody told me that was coming.
I was turned down and the email did not say why. I asked twice and got the same paragraph.
It told me to switch to the app to finish. I do not want another app on my phone.
Four days waiting and then a text asking for the same document again.
My passport photo would not scan in the shop lighting.
No idea whether anyone was looking at it. A progress bar would have been enough.
I did not agree to a face scan when I signed up for a shopping account.
I am 19 and have never had a credit card. It said it could not find me.
Gave up after a week. Applied again later and got stuck at the same step.
The decline letter listed general factors that could apply to anyone.
Fine until it wanted a utility bill I do not have because everything is in my partner name.
Once a person looked at it the whole thing took four minutes.
The in-store kiosk kept logging me out of the shopping app while I browsed.
